# Gamma

Gamma helps create beautiful, interactive content and presentations using AI. This integration enables programmatic generation via Gamma’s API.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gamma/.

## Actions

- **Generate a Gamma**: Create a new gamma generation.
- **Get Gamma File URLs** (read-only): Retrieve generation status and file urls.
